title: The three pillars of ESG
caption: Investors look at environmental, social and governance issues together. Materiality asks which matter most in a given industry: water for drinks makers, data privacy for banks.
alt: Three boxes: environmental, social and governance, each with the issues it covers.
description: Environmental: greenhouse gas emissions, energy use, pollution, water, waste and biodiversity.
Social: employee health and safety, pay and conditions, diversity, human rights in supply chains.
Governance: board independence and diversity, executive pay, shareholder rights, audit, bribery and tax practices.
